purpose: One bounded published-reference benchmark: probability of an observed captured projection label from measured endogenous genes and measured source position, against fixed controls, evaluated on held-out biological groups.
not_authorized: No real-data fit until ROOT reviews this code and a biological protocol with margins and power is committed
No automatic PASS: the biological gate is NOT_EVALUATED in every run
No new packages, remote author code execution, old test reopening or viewer work

endpoint.mode_required: manifest endpoint_mode must be 'capture_per_target' or 'exclusive_two_target'; no default
endpoint.capture_per_target: e.g. PFC cells with a captured LHA label: y=1 captured; y=0 only for a QC-passed nondetection in an assayed group; failed-QC and unassayed rows are unknown and excluded
endpoint.exclusive_two_target: e.g. Rossi LHb-only vs VTA-only: among cells assayed and QC-passed for both targets, y=1 first-target-only, y=0 second-target-only; double-labelled and neither are kept as separate counted statuses and excluded
endpoint.semantics: Observed capture only, never a verified absence of projection; unknown masks stay unknown
endpoint.probability_reported: P(captured label | measured genes, measured position, assay), not a biological projection probability
endpoint.separation: PFC->LHA capture (SPIDER-type) and Rossi LHb-only/VTA-only are different endpoint modes and are never pooled

manifest_requirements_checked_before_any: software-only release: any manifest with synthetic != true is refused first, before any file is hashed or parsed
synthetic flag (true only for the software test)
group_unit is 'animal' or 'pool'; slice, section and hemisphere are refused as group units
every group lists true animal identities with no repeats; pools list member animals, no animal may appear in two groups (overlapping pool members refused), and every group has independence evidence
independent power approval (approved_by, reference, min_groups) with at least min_groups groups present
declared endogenous gene list, position columns, technical columns and targets
file SHA-256 for cells, genes, labels and mask must match
predictor roles (genes, position, technical) and targets: non-empty, unique, unpadded names; predictor roles disjoint; every predictor name passes the name rules
animal IDs inside groups must be non-blank and unpadded (so 'A00 ' cannot pass as disjoint from 'A00')
data_checks: cell_id unique in cells and genes tables; identical cell sets (exact join)
(cell_id, target) unique in labels with columns cell_id,target,captured,qc_pass; captured and qc_pass only 0/1
mask covers every group x target exactly once with assayed in 0/1
every assayed group x target cell has exactly one label; any label in an unassayed group x target is refused
gene columns equal the declared endogenous list exactly; reporter/vector/barcode/target/class/cluster names refused in genes and technical columns
no missing or non-finite values; gene counts non-negative
per-endpoint eligible biological groups (groups with >= 1 eligible cell) must reach power_approval.min_groups; a global group count does not qualify a target assayed in fewer groups
every method output must be a numeric vector of shape (n_eval,), finite and within [0, 1] before assignment; scalars, wrong shapes, non-finite or out-of-range values are a FAIL

candidate.model: sklearn 1.8 LogisticRegression (L2 via the default; penalty not passed because it is deprecated in 1.8)
candidate.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on training cells of the fold only
candidate.fit_weights: group-balanced: 1/n_group per training cell, normalised to mean 1; no class_weight

controls.technical: same logistic settings and group-balanced weights on declared technical columns only
controls.molecular_knn: KNeighborsClassifier k=15 on fit-scaled log1p genes
controls.naive_bayes: GaussianNB with group-balanced weights on fit-scaled log1p genes
controls.knn_note: KNN controls are unweighted (KNeighborsClassifier has no sample weights)

folds.unit: declared biological group (animal or verified-disjoint pool)
folds.scheme: groups shuffled with seed 20261112 and dealt into min(5, n_groups) outer folds; every cell of a group stays in one fold
folds.per_target: train = assayed cells of training groups; evaluate = assayed cells of held-out groups
folds.unevaluable: a fold/endpoint with one training class or fewer than 15 training cells is a FAIL (Refusal); no fallback
folds.identical_queries: every method is scored on the identical eligible cell IDs and folds; any missing or non-finite probability is a FAIL, never a dropped row; the eligible-ID SHA-256 is recorded

metrics.brier: per group mean (p - y)^2, then mean over groups (animal-weighted), per target; macro mean over targets
metrics.log_loss: per group mean -(y log p + (1-y) log(1-p)) with clipped p, then group-weighted as Brier
metrics.calibration_diagnostics: 10 equal-width bins of pooled held-out predictions (count, mean p, observed rate), cell-weighted ECE, per-group mean p vs observed rate
metrics.discrimination: pooled held-out AUC (rank-based) when both classes are present

gate.biological: NOT_EVALUATED: no committed biological protocol, margins or power
synthetic_software_checks: candidate group-weighted Brier and log loss below constant_0.5 and fit_frequency
candidate Brier below location_knn, molecular_knn and technical (recoverable gene + position signal)
unequal group sizes; hand-computed group-weighted Brier and log loss match the code to 1e-12
fitted scalers, coefficients, frequency and NB parameters identical after changing hidden evaluation-group features and labels
unassayed and failed-QC rows unknown; every planted refusal (21) raised
gate.synthetic_pass_meaning: software works on planted data only; says nothing about biology

real_data: Non-synthetic manifests are refused by run_manifest/validate_manifest in this software-only release; no real-data command exists. Real fitting needs ROOT review, a committed biological protocol with margins and power, and resolution of the SPIDER same-mouse blocker.

name_rules.reporter_aliases_exact_token: name tokens (split on non-alphanumerics) equal to a reporter/vector alias, e.g. GFP, EGFP, EYFP, tdTomato, mCherry, Cre, Flp, WPRE, AAV, are refused; endogenous symbols such as Gfpt1, Gfpt2, Creb1, Crem are admitted
name_rules.also_refused: reserved column names and any target name

load_order: cells, labels and mask are parsed and checked first (IDs non-blank, mask content 0/1 and complete, endpoint derivation, per-endpoint eligible biological group count >= power min_groups); the gene matrix is parsed last
canonical_order: after cell IDs are validated, cells are stably sorted by cell_id before endpoint derivation, gene join, folds and fitting; results are invariant to CSV row order (exact cell-ID joins retained)
